name: cairo
title: Cairo · a ZK contract workbench
description: A Cairo/Starknet zero-knowledge contract workbench. Scaffold a Cairo 2 contract, vibecode it with an agent, build it and run its snforge tests — each contract is a self-contained Scarb project mounted as its own submod under orbit/cairo/<name>. Thin orchestration (Python stdlib) over the real toolchain already on this box: scarb 2.8.4, starknet-foundry (snforge/sncast) 0.31, universal-sierra-compiler. The 'vibecode' loop drives the headless Claude CLI, scoped to one submod, to write or edit Cairo and then verifies with build + test.
state: Contracts live in-tree as submods at orbit/cairo/<name>/ (one Scarb project each). No external state dir; scarb target/ and .snfoundry_cache/ are gitignored.

endpoints.GET /cairo/api/toolchain: scarb / snforge / sncast / claude presence + versions
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/get?name=: One submod: Scarb.toml, files, build state
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/read?name=&path=: Read a file inside a submod
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/write: Write a file inside a submod (name, path, content)
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/test: snforge test (name); no name = module self-test; async=true -> job
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/vibe: Agent-edit then build + test (name, prompt, model?); async=true -> job
endpoints.note: The app self-calls the same handlers under /cairo/_api/*; /api/cairo/* is the permanent legacy alias.

safety: vibe() runs the Claude CLI with --permission-mode acceptEdits scoped to a single submod directory (--add-dir), so edits and scarb/snforge runs stay inside that contract's project. It uses the host Claude OAuth credentials and spends against them. No keys are deployed and nothing is sent to a live chain; sncast is present for the user to deploy by hand. The server binds 127.0.0.1 (CAIRO_HOST to widen) and has no auth, so route stays false: exposing it would let anyone write files and spend the host Claude account.

layout.src/mod.py: anchor: new / vibe / build / test / ... (Python stdlib)
layout.src/api/server.py: stdlib HTTP server: protocol API + job table + serves the console
layout.src/build.sh: build the console -> src/releases/<ts>, flip src/dist atomically
layout.<name>/: one contract submod per dir (a Scarb project)
